calls.video_title: A Once in a 100 Year Investment Opportunity Just Started (Felix Nikolas Prehn on Where He's Buying)
calls.thesis: BUY — first tracked. Wheaton Precious Metals is a royalty/streaming company, not a miner: finances miners for a share of production, so no operational risk, diversified across many miners, plus good silver exposure.
calls.base_case: Royalty model removes operational risk while keeping gold/silver upside.
calls.bull_case: Gold and silver rebound; streaming margins expand.
calls.bear_case: Miners it finances run into trouble and streams underdeliver.
